title: HAXcms site folder contract (format)
description: The format of haxcms-site-contract.json: a list of path entries describing what a HAXcms site folder may hold. Paths are relative to the site root and use `/`. In a path, `*` matches within one segment and `**` matches any depth. A path without a wildcard is matched first; otherwise the first matching entry in list order wins.

levels.description: Conformance levels, lowest first. Each level includes the ones before it.

ignore.description: Top-level names a validator never walks into (version control and installed dependencies).

path.description: Path relative to the site root. No leading `/`, no `..`, no backslash.

status.description: required: must exist from `level` up. optional: may exist. retired: no longer written; an existing site may still hold it, a newly made site must not.

level.description: For a required entry, the lowest conformance level that requires it.

owner.description: authored: a person or tool writes it and HAXcms never overwrites it. managed: HAXcms rewrites the whole file on rebuild. partly-managed: HAXcms owns one part (see policy), the site owner the rest. generated: rebuilt from site.json or page content. scaffold: copied once when the site is made, then the owner's. deployment: placed by whatever serves the site, not part of its content.

policy.description: How a managed file is kept in sync: replace (whole file), block (between HAXcms markers), json-merge (HAXcms keys win, others kept).

boilerplate.description: True when the backends' site boilerplate ships this path. The backends' tests compare their boilerplate with these entries.

schema.description: File in this folder that describes the entry's content.

rule.description: A check beyond the path existing. item-location: required once per item in site.json, at that item's `location`.

replacedBy.description: For a retired entry, the path that took its place.
